mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals an overheating economy where monetary tightening is insufficient to cool demand, leading to heightened inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously, or Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rising housing starts index (HOUST) signals robust demand for residential construction that correlates with higher corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods within the late-cycle expansion regime when HOUST rises, or Rank IC for the HOUST rise signal within the regime over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust demand and supply conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO rise simultaneously, or Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production growth regime, a sustained increase in manufacturing output (INDPRO) signals strong supply chain conditions that reduce input costs and boost corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods within the high industrial production growth regime when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
